node.title: Re: The problem of "the" default shell
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Excellent post, thank you very much for this! Bookmarked :-)

Did you notice that qx() and its shorter alias `` don't support a list form?

[mod://IPC::System::Simple] provides the function capturex as a replacement for qx that always avoids the shell*.

[mod://IPC::Run3] is another good module that will avoid the shell* if you give it an arrayref. The more advanced [mod://IPC::Run], although its documentation does not mention this, will also [https://metacpan.org/source/TODDR/IPC-Run-0.96/lib/IPC/Run.pm#L1271|use] the exec {...} ... form, although I haven't yet fully traced back in how many cases this is used - it's [id://1203514|not always].

I wrote a post in a similar vein to yours showing example code with these modules [id://1180578|here].

* [id://1199200|Does not apply on Windows], but I have heard good things about [mod://Win32::ShellQuote], which recent versions of [mod://IPC::Run3] use internally. On *NIX systems and others with [man://execvp;3|execvp(3)], the above should always completely avoid the shell.

Update 2: Cleaned up formatting and wording.

(Side note: I don't normally both front-page and reply to a node, but I feel this is an important topic.)
